name: Event Steward
summary: Defines and validates generic append-only event envelopes and causal references.
description: Consumes domain-neutral event append plans with explicit identity, schema version, causation, and idempotency. Does not own event persistence, replay infrastructure, application workflow composition, or a particular event taxonomy.

distinguished_from.how: Plans immutable causal event records rather than applying current-state transitions to versioned records.
